overview: This single-page file index concerns labor regulation in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records two communications from Vincent at Dairen: one reporting that alien employment was unrestricted in the territory, and another describing the temporary admission and residence of certain classes of aliens for employment, based on information from the Kwantung Government Marine Police and accompanied by a translation of Ordinance No. 15 of March 20, 1948. The second communication is cross-referenced to file 894C.55/7; the underlying communications themselves are not reproduced here.

subfiles.about: The index describes two communications concerning alien employment and immigration controls in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: The first entry, dated November 10, records a communication from Vincent at Dairen stating that there were no restrictions on the employment of aliens in the Kwantung Leased Territory. The second, dated November 28, records Dairen communication no. 107 on the temporary admission and residence of certain types of aliens for employment. That report transmitted information received from the Kwantung Government Marine Police and enclosed a translation of Ordinance No. 15, dated March 20, 1948; the index directs readers to file 894C.55/7.

interest: The page is useful as a documentary roadmap rather than as a substantive report: it identifies two otherwise absent communications and preserves their dates, provenance, and principal conclusions. Particularly notable is the contrast between an assertion that alien employment was unrestricted and the existence of an ordinance governing the admission and residence of aliens seeking work. The cross-reference to 894C.55/7 may help historians locate the full report and translated ordinance and reconstruct the administration of foreign labor in postwar Dairen and the Kwantung territory.
